description: This Java class, SwaggerRedirectController, is a Spring MVC controller that provides redirect endpoints to the Swagger UI documentation. It maps common paths (/swagger-ui, /swagger-ui.html) to the actual Swagger UI location (/docs) for easier access and discoverability.

classes.name: SwaggerRedirectController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that provides redirect endpoints for Swagger UI at /docs.

methods.name: redirectToDocs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /swagger-ui and /swagger-ui.html by redirecting clients to /docs Swagger UI page.
